Lotus Root 12.4.13 · 16 Nov 2026

The Napoleon network upgrade: required before 21 December 2026

⬇ Download 12.4.13What is newQuick start
ImportantEvery node operator, pool and exchange must run 12.4.13 or later before 2026-12-21 20:50 UTC.
A node on an older version, or on any LotusiaStewardship release, leaves the chain at the first block that uses the new rules. There is no grace period.
Miners and pools that build their own coinbase must add the UTXO set commitment before that date.
WarningKnown issue, fixed in 12.4.15: these binaries cannot create or load an SQLite wallet, and a node started with -wallet= on such a wallet does not start. If you use the wallet, install 12.4.15.

Highlights

  • Merged mining. From Napoleon a Lotus block can be mined together with Bitcoin or Litecoin: one parent header proves one Lotus block.
  • Contract opcodes. New script opcodes for contracts (introspection, OP_MUL, OP_MULDIV, Taproot state, OP_CHECKBLOCKHASHVERIFY) activate at Napoleon.
  • UTXO set commitment. From Napoleon every block commits to the UTXO set in its coinbase, so a snapshot can be checked against the chain.
  • UTXO snapshots. A node can start from a UTXO snapshot and validate the history in the background. Full nodes write one every 100 blocks.
  • No more limit of 3 OP_RETURN outputs per transaction, from Napoleon.
  • Before Napoleon nothing changes: a 12.4.13 node validates, relays and mines exactly like 12.4.11.

Compatibility and rollback

Consensus rulesyes. New rules activate at Napoleon, when the median time past of the previous block reaches 1797886200 (2026-12-21 20:50 UTC)
Minimum version on the network12.4.13, required from Napoleon (2026-12-21 20:50 UTC)
NapoleonEvery node must run 12.5.1 or later before 2026-12-21 20:50 UTC. This version does not.
UpgradingStop the node, replace the binaries, start it. The data directory is kept.
Going backStop the node and put the previous binaries back. Going back is not always possible once a newer version has written to the data directory; the release says when.

Install and verify

Docker 
docker pull ghcr.io/lotusdevorg/lotusd:12.4.13
docker run -d --name lotusd -v lotus-data:/data ghcr.io/lotusdevorg/lotusd:12.4.13
Linux 
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases/releases/download/v12.4.13/SHA256SUMS
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases/releases/download/v12.4.13/lotus-binaries-12.4.13-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
sha256sum -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS     # must print: OK
tar -xzf lotus-binaries-12.4.13-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
./lotus-binaries-12.4.13-linux-x86_64/lotusd -version
macOS

The same steps with lotus-binaries-12.4.13-macos-x86_64.tar.gz; check with shasum -a 256 -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS. macOS asks for confirmation before the first launch (the binaries are not notarised).

Windows

Download lotus-binaries-12.4.13-windows-x86_64.zip and SHA256SUMS. In PowerShell, Get-FileHash .\lotus-binaries-12.4.13-windows-x86_64.zip -Algorithm SHA256 must give the value on that file's line. Then unzip.

Download Lotus binaries from github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases only, and check them against SHA256SUMS.
